pages.seoDescription: Who Iris Optical is, what we do and the people behind the work.

children: We opened Iris Optical to do eyewear the way we always wanted it done — a real exam that isn’t rushed, a curated wall of frames worth the wait, and a stylist who treats choosing them as the good part.
No pushy add-ons, no chain-store scripts. Just careful eye care and beautiful, well-fitted glasses you’re glad to be seen in.
